description: This file declares functions related to reftable buffer management and writing, including setting hashes, creating writers, and writing data into buffers.

methods.name: cl_reftable_set_hash
methods.description: Sets the hash value at a specified position within a reftable buffer.

methods.name: cl_reftable_strbuf_writer
methods.description: Creates and returns a reftable writer object that writes into a given buffer with specified options.

methods.name: cl_reftable_write_to_buf
methods.description: Writes reftable reference and log records into the provided buffer using specified options.
